lenses.brief: RS, THE FINAL RE-SCORE OF ALL FOURTEEN JUDGED ITEMS, J1-J14 (Part B §B2), on the reviewed commit, in first person at the default settings, against the concepts and the look bible (docs/milestones/M4-look-bible.md), not against M3. Record what each item needs (at least C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C7, C10, C11, C14, 'Look: my arms and legs' and 'Look: my knockdown'), cut full-resolution stills and crops (tools/look_sheets.sh), and LOOK at them beside the concepts and beside the six lenses' before-fix stills. Score each item 0, 1 or 2 in `scores`, with the frame or crop that decides it and, for each, whether the fixes moved it from the six lenses' score and why (put that in the evidence text). Be honest and independent: a fix that landed but still reads as acceptable rather than production stays a 1; an item can also go down. In `summary` give the fourteen scores, the mean, whether Part B's rule passes (no 0, every critical item at 1 or more, mean at least 1.5), and for every item still at 1 the single change that would most likely raise it to 2. File findings only for defects that cost an item a point or score a 0 (at most 8).
